text: DeepSeek Chat 是一个 DSH 桌面插件，在左侧栏增加 DeepSeek 聊天入口，并在主面板内打开 chat.deepseek.com。它通过桌面端浏览器租约桥创建 Electron webview，记录最近访问的会话链接，离开面板后再次打开可恢复会话。登录页面不会覆盖已记住的会话；失效链接会回退到站点首页。插件还会在内嵌页面启动失败或进程退出时显示面板内重试入口，并限制为具备桌面浏览器桥的桌面环境。适合希望在 DSH 中直接使用 DeepSeek Chat 的用户；需登录 DeepSeek 账号。

DeepSeek Chat adds a sidebar panel to DSH desktop and loads chat.deepseek.com through its browser bridge. It saves the latest conversation, ignores sign-in pages, and returns unavailable chats to the site home. Failed webviews show a retry action. Requires desktop DSH and a DeepSeek account.

内嵌聊天页加载失败时，能不能在面板里重试？
我想在一个桌面工作区里使用 DeepSeek 网页聊天。
Is there a way to open DeepSeek Chat inside my DSH desktop app?
I want the sidebar to reopen the conversation I was viewing.
DeepSeek Chat 的功能「侧栏聊天面板」：在 DSH 桌面侧栏注册聊天入口，选择后在主区域呈现聊天面板，并通过桌面浏览器桥加载 DeepSeek Chat。
DeepSeek Chat 的功能「恢复最近会话」：面板导航时保存 chat.deepseek.com 会话链接到 localStorage；再次进入时打开保存的链接，登录页不覆盖记录。
DeepSeek Chat 的功能「失效会话回退」：恢复保存的会话失败时，自动导航回 DeepSeek Chat 首页，让用户从可用页面继续。
DeepSeek Chat 的功能「面板内故障重试」：webview 进程退出、被销毁或启动超时时，面板显示错误状态和重试按钮；点击后重新创建加载流程。
DeepSeek Chat 直接在面板加载 chat.deepseek.com，首次使用需在站点登录；DSH 的内存浏览器分区会在应用退出后清除登录 cookie，因此重启后需重新登录。

dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat README · 功能：- 左侧栏图标入口，排在「插件」和「自动化任务」之间。
- 主内容区全宽内嵌 `https://chat.deepseek.com/`（Electron `<webview>`，走桌面壳的 guest 租约桥 `window.dshDesktop.browser`）。
- **记住上次会话**：切到别的面板、切换会话、重启 App 后再进来，直接回到上次那条对话，而不是新对话。
- 登录/鉴权页不会覆盖记忆；记住的会话失效或打不开时自动回退到首页。
- **崩溃隔离**：内嵌页进程退出、被销毁或启动超时，只在面板里显示「重试」，不会再出现整个 App 变空白窗口的问题（v0.4.0 修复，见下文）。
- 纯 Web 表层（`dsh web` 在浏览器里打开）自动不注册——该站点 `frame-ancestors 'none'`，iframe 嵌不了，guest 租约桥也只有桌面壳提供。

dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat README · 使用：- 第一次打开会停在 chat.deepseek.com 的登录页，登录一次即可。
- 本次 App 运行期间，切换面板/会话不需要重新登录。
- **重启 DSH 后需要重新登录一次**：DSH 目前给内嵌浏览器的是内存分区（`dsh-sidebar-browser-<uuid>`，没有 `persist:` 前缀），进程退出即清空 cookie。本插件不修改 DSH 的安装文件，所以不会绕过这一限制；想做到「登录一次、长期免登录」，可直接运行仓库自带的补丁脚本 **[docs/patch-dsh-persistent-partition.cjs](docs/patch-dsh-persistent-partition.cjs)**（已适配 `0.2.1-rc.3` 的 ASAR integrity，支持 `--dry-run`、自动备份与全量校验），说明见 **[docs/login-persistence.md](docs/login-persistence.md)**。
- 会话链接记在 App 的 localStorage（key `dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat:last-url`），重启后仍会打开上次的会话（前提是已登录且该会话仍存在）。

dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat README · 登录态持久化（可选，免登录）：DSH 目前给内嵌浏览器分配的是**内存分区**（`dsh-sidebar-browser-${randomUUID()}`，无 `persist:` 前缀），所以每次重启 App 都会清空 cookie。想做到「登录一次、以后不再登录」，需要把桌面主进程里的那行分区名改成固定且带 `persist:` 前缀的值——两条语句**字节数相同**，可以直接在 `resources/app.asar` 里原地替换。

完整原因、脚本、验证步骤、回滚方式和各平台路径都整理在这里：

**→ [docs/login-persistence.md](docs/login-persistence.md)**

补丁脚本（仓库自带，Node 18+，零依赖）：

```powershell
section: 登录态持久化（可选，免登录）

text: dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat README · 打补丁（自动备份）：node docs/patch-dsh-persistent-partition.cjs "F:\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar"

dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat README · 只检查、不写盘：node docs/patch-dsh-persistent-partition.cjs "F:\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar" --dry-run
```

脚本已适配 `0.2.1-rc.3` 的逐文件 ASAR `integrity`（自动重算并同步 `lib/main.js` 的 SHA256），支持幂等重跑（已打补丁直接返回 0）、自动备份、写入前后全量校验，以及 `--dry-run` 预演。

注意：这属于对已安装应用的修改，不在 DSH 支持范围内；DSH 升级会覆盖 `app.asar`，需要重新打补丁（`Partitions` 里的登录数据不会丢）。请先备份，风险自负。

dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat README · 已知限制：- chat.deepseek.com 会检测 Electron 内嵌环境，偶尔弹出「使用环境异常…建议使用官方产品」的提示；这是站点侧行为，与本插件无关。
- 仅桌面版有效；`dsh web` 在浏览器里打开时不显示入口。
- 站点若调整会话 URL 规则（当前识别 `/a/chat/s/<id>` 形式），「记住会话」可能失效并回退到首页。

dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat README · 崩溃隔离（v0.4.0）：早期版本出现过：点开面板、聊天页正常显示 1~2 秒后**整个 App 变成空白窗口**（只剩原生菜单和窗口按钮），没有崩溃对话框也没有 `crash-*.log`。

根因是 React 卸载面板时**先移除 DOM、后执行 effect 清理**，而 Electron 的 `<webview>` 一旦脱离文档，`getURL()` 就会抛错；DSH 把插件里任何未捕获异常都当作 `slot entry crashed in 'root'`，直接卸载 `root` slot —— 整个 App UI 因此消失。

现在的实现：

dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat README · 崩溃隔离（v0.4.0）：- 所有 guest 调用先判断 `element.isConnected` 再 `try/catch`，清理阶段「先读 URL、再移除元素」；
- 每个事件处理器都包 `try/catch`，异常只落在面板自己的状态里；
- 面板外包一层 React 错误边界；
- 监听 `render-process-gone` / `destroyed` / `did-fail-load`，guest 出问题时面板内显示「重试」；
- 15 秒启动看门狗，guest 一直不 `dom-ready` 就转重试卡片。

```

`test/check-client.mjs` 是离线自检：在 `node:vm` 里加载 `lib/client.js`，用假的 React/DOM/租约桥验证注册、会话记忆、租约释放和崩溃隔离（DOM 先移除再清理不抛错、guest 崩溃不逃逸、反复开关不漏租约）。

dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat README · dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat：English | [中文](README.md)

Adds a **DeepSeek Chat** entry to the **DeepSeek Harness (DSH) desktop** sidebar. Clicking it opens `chat.deepseek.com` full-width in the main area and remembers the last conversation.

> Repository: [GitHub](https://github.com/sweet560/dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat) | [Gitee mirror](https://gitee.com/wtt520wyl/dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat)

dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat README · Features：- Sidebar icon entry, placed between **Plugins** and **Scheduled tasks**.
- Full-width embedded `https://chat.deepseek.com/` (Electron `<webview>` through the desktop guest-lease bridge `window.dshDesktop.browser`).
- **Last-conversation memory**: switching panels/sessions or restarting the app reopens the conversation you left, not a new chat.
- Auth pages never overwrite that memory; a dead conversation falls back to the site root.
- **Crash containment**: if the embedded page's process dies, is destroyed, or never starts, the panel shows a Retry card — the app window no longer goes blank (fixed in v0.4.0).
- Inert on the plain Web surface (`dsh web`): the site sends `frame-ancestors 'none'`, so an iframe cannot carry it, and the guest bridge only exists in the desktop shell.

|---|---|
| DSH | Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer |
| Platform | Windows / macOS / Linux desktop shell |
| git | Only for the GitHub install route (pnpm fetches the repository) |

dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat README · Usage：- The first visit shows the chat.deepseek.com sign-in page; sign in once.
- Within one app run, switching panels or sessions keeps you signed in.
- **Sign in again after restarting DSH**: DSH currently gives embedded browsers an in-memory partition (`dsh-sidebar-browser-<uuid>`, no `persist:` prefix), so cookies are dropped when the process exits. This plugin does not modify DSH's installation files, so it cannot bypass that. To sign in once and stay signed in, run the bundled patch script **[docs/patch-dsh-persistent-partition.cjs](docs/patch-dsh-persistent-partition.cjs)** (rc.3 ASAR-integrity aware, supports `--dry-run`, automatic backup and full verification); see **[docs/login-persistence.md](docs/login-persistence.md)**.
- The conversation URL is stored in the app's localStorage (`dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat:last-url`), so the last conversation is restored after a restart (while signed in and while it still exists).

dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat README · Persistent login (optional)：DSH hands embedded browsers an **in-memory partition** (`dsh-sidebar-browser-${randomUUID()}`, no `persist:` prefix), so every app restart drops the cookies. To sign in once and stay signed in, replace that partition with a fixed `persist:` one inside `resources/app.asar` — the two statements are the same length, so the archive can be patched byte-for-byte in place.

Cause, script, verification, rollback and per-platform paths:

**→ [docs/login-persistence.md](docs/login-persistence.md)**

dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat README · Persistent login (optional)：Bundled patch script (Node 18+, no dependencies):

```powershell
dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat README · Patch (creates a timestamped backup first)：node docs/patch-dsh-persistent-partition.cjs "F:\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar"

dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat README · Dry run: check without writing：node docs/patch-dsh-persistent-partition.cjs "F:\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar" --dry-run
```

The script understands the per-file ASAR `integrity` metadata shipped by `0.2.1-rc.3` (it recomputes and syncs `lib/main.js`'s SHA256), is idempotent (already patched returns 0), creates an automatic backup, verifies every block hash before and after writing, and supports `--dry-run`.

dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat README · Dry run: check without writing：Note: this modifies the installed application and is outside DSH's support; a DSH update overwrites `app.asar` and the patch must be re-applied (the `Partitions` data survives). Back up first and proceed at your own risk.

dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat README · Known limitations：- chat.deepseek.com detects the Electron embedding and occasionally shows a "usage environment is abnormal" notice. That is site-side behaviour, unrelated to this plugin.
- Desktop only; `dsh web` in a browser shows no entry.
- If the site changes its conversation URL scheme (currently `/a/chat/s/<id>`), the memory falls back to the site root.

dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat README · Crash containment (v0.4.0)：Earlier versions could leave the whole app a blank window a second or two after opening the panel, with no crash dialog and no `crash-*.log`.

Root cause: React runs effect cleanups after it has removed the DOM, and Electron's `<webview>` throws from `getURL()` once detached. DSH treats any uncaught plugin error as `slot entry crashed in 'root'` and unmounts the root slot — the entire UI.

dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat README · Crash containment (v0.4.0)：The current implementation guards every guest call behind an `isConnected` check and `try/catch`, reads the URL before removing the element, wraps every event handler, puts a React error boundary around the panel, listens for `render-process-gone` / `destroyed` / `did-fail-load`, and has a 15-second start watchdog.

git clone https://github.com/sweet560/dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat.git

node test/check-client.mjs
```

`test/check-client.mjs` loads `lib/client.js` in a `node:vm` sandbox with fake React/DOM/bridge objects and checks registration, conversation memory, lease release, and crash containment.
